harnessContract.tree: conversation.input.overlay anchor > div.card[aria-label] > input.search + error[role=alert]? + status? + div.viewport[role=listbox] > div.row[role=option][aria-selected]
harnessContract.focus: the popup search input owns focus while open; Escape and successful selection call the injected focusComposer callback
harnessContract.stateOwner: a per-session controller owns transient open/load/filter/highlight/submitting/confirmation state; option loading and selection are injected business callbacks
harnessContract.liveness: reopen, dismiss and dispose revoke the prior binding's write rights and abort its fetch; the closed view renders null
harnessContract.risk: a selected option may replace the card with controlled RiskConfirmation until acknowledged

vcpCandidate.productionConsumer: none; conversation.input.overlay, the input machine and Composer wiring are frozen
